name: Casper Ruud

observed.title: Carlos Alcaraz vs Casper Ruud Court-Level Highlights | Paris 2026
observed.camera: court-level, behind the near player (players large and sharp)

appearance.hair: brown, short, held back by the headband

forehand.note: Earlier 'high loop takeback' (v1 84.6-85.5) was wrong: those frames are Ruud walking after the point. No clear forehand in this video.

backhand.hands: two (drive); one (defensive slice on the stretch)

drive.stance: open: loads the left leg, right leg trailing
drive.takeback: compact, racket at hip height behind the left side, short loop

slice.stance: deep lunge onto the left leg at full stretch
slice.swing: one hand, long straight right arm reaching low; left arm thrown up behind for balance

running.ready: very wide, upright stance behind the baseline; sways side to side while receiving
running.splitStep: both feet off the ground just as the server hits (v1 168.6), lands wide
running.firstStep: crossover; long running strides to the forehand side
running.braking: deep lunge on the outside leg (v1 25.2)
running.recovery: crossover then shuffle back to the middle

mannerisms: touches the headband / wipes his face walking back between points (v1 31.4-33.0, v1 85.7-86.8, v1 172-173)

gameHints.player-artist: Blue shirt, light-grey shorts, white headband and white wristbands, white shoes; tall and upright.
gameHints.racket-coach: Backhand drive: two hands, compact hip-height takeback, high finish over the right shoulder. Defensive backhand: one-handed slice at full stretch. Serve: side-on, high toss, kick-back of the right leg on landing.
gameHints.animator: Very wide receiving stance with a sway; airborne split step timed to the serve; deep lunge with the free arm thrown up on the slice; headband touch between points.
gameHints.body-animator: Lunge onto the left leg for the stretched slice; land the serve on the left foot with the right leg kicked back.

notSeen: forehand (no clear forehand near the camera in v1)
forehand and backhand finishes on a normal rally ball

serve.routine: stands side-on, looks at the box, bounces the ball with the racket held low
serve.toss: left arm straight up, high toss
serve.trophy: racket behind the head, knees bent
serve.contact: full reach up and into the court
serve.landing: lands on the front (left) foot, right leg kicks back
